rationale: No blocking findings: the previous CR-001 (exclusion bypassed when a hook has no cwd) is fixed in the uncommitted working tree in both gates (`return excludedProjects.length > 0`) and covered by new tests, and no new patch/decision_needed issue survived triage. Confidence is medium, not high: the lenses reviewed the 12 non-test source files (+930/-11) in full against the spec, but the 2k-line test diff and docs were only consulted as coverage evidence, no lint/typecheck/tests were run, the spec is partly SUPERSEDED, and the Jira ticket text itself was not read. Triage counts: 0 patch, 0 defer, ~25 dismissed (speculative or low-impact: concurrent CLI writes with no lock, transient EBUSY read treated as corrupt (fails closed), preferences `version` downgrade, relative hook cwd, no-op commands rewriting the file, 'include' message when a parent still covers the child, `status` using process.cwd() vs project root, duplicated prefs modules, typo paths accepted, Copilot Chat double gate evaluation). Follow-ups that are not blockers: (1) the parity plan still says an undefined cwd must resolve to 'not excluded' while code and tests now fail closed - amend plan text; (2) record that the gate is evaluated per event (live changes) rather than pinned per session; (3) README documents only the default Claude connector, not --copilot-cli-otlp/--copilot-chat-otlp; (4) `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` is still not honoured by getClaudeSettingsPath (pre-existing); (5) commit the working-tree fix with a conventional message (scope `analytics`).
